_doc: Explicit per-(card,sink) whitelist of golds permitted to carry a free-text residual sink. STATELESS INVARIANT: any gold x sink NOT listed here must be free-text-free, else loud failure (DestringSinkRatchetTests -> renamed FreeTextWhitelistTests). Each entry is a NAMED carve-out: tag 'debt' = slated for a burndown slice (see libs/magic-ast/docs/gold-burndown-plan.md); tag 'irreducible' = permanent, no structured representation. A listed (card,sink) that no longer carries the sink also fails (remove it). Replaces the opaque aggregate count baseline destring-sink-baseline.json (de-ratcheted 2026-06-16).

entries.reason: WAVE-4 NARROWED (ADR 0004 #40 wave-4): the SOLE surviving free-text sink. The Prowl OtherCondition on this card was structured this wave (PlayerDealtDamageThisTurnCondition.Combat+Source). The remaining composite 'Search target opponent's library for an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then that player shuffles.' is blocked on ONE structural gap: SearchLibraryEffect.Destination is a required non-nullable enum with no member for 'found but NOT relocated to a zone — cast from the library in place' (CR 701.20 search + CR 601 cast-from-library). The whose-library axis the prior wave flagged is now solved (SearchLibraryEffect.Player={Kind:Target,Filter:{EntityType:player}}), and the leaf effects all exist (SearchLibraryEffect, CastWithoutPayingEffect, ShuffleEffect). Forcing a Destination (Hand/Battlefield/etc.) would misstate the CR (the card is not moved by the search). CLOSES with a SearchDestination.None/Retained sentinel (mirroring the existing Distributed sentinel that defers to Placements) plus a 3-effect CompositeEffect [search(Destination=None), OptionalEffect(CastWithoutPaying(It)), Shuffle(ThatPlayer)] — held for a dedicated wave-5 slice coordinated with the SearchLibraryEffect owner to avoid a unilateral required-field/discriminator change mid-wave
